items.title: Microsoft Teams: Set and manage meeting timers in Teams Rooms on Windows
items.desc: Keep meetings on track with a shared countdown timer in Microsoft Teams Rooms on Windows. Start, pause, resume, or cancel a timer from the room’s touch console, with the countdown visible on the front-of-room display and in participants’ meeting views. Available with a Teams Rooms Pro license.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Human Resources: Streamline the employee offboarding experience
items.desc:
Business value
When an employee leaves, HR, managers, IT, facilities and payroll all have work to do, but the termination hasn't been connected to the request that starts the exit or the work that follows. Manual coordination can leave access open, property unreturned and final pay incomplete. This feature connects the termination to a governed, visible exit journey, so HR runs consistent exits with less follow-up.
Capability details
Separation requests: Employees resign and managers request separations in self service, with approval and policies per company and worker type.
Safer termination: Notice details, configurable checks, bulk…
items.when: GA: June CY2027 · Preview: March CY2027

items.title: Dynamics 365 Human Resources: Ask HR - conversational HR self-service grounded in your own worker record
items.desc:
Business value
Employees and managers routinely contact HR for answers their HR system already holds — how much leave they have, what their policy allows in their location, where a request has reached. The information exists, but it is spread across separate records, so a generic answer is often wrong for the individual asking. Workforce intelligence answers those questions from the person's own worker record, plan enrolment and jurisdiction, and lets them complete the related transaction in the same conversation, so routine requests are resolved directly and HR teams can focus on work that needs judgment.
Capability details
Personal…
items.when: GA: March CY2027 · Preview: February CY2026

items.title: Exchange: Enable High Volume Email (HVE) for External Recipients
items.desc: High Volume Email (HVE) External Sending extends HVE in Exchange Online, which today sends only to recipients inside your organization, so it can also deliver bulk email to external recipients such as customers and partners. It is designed for operational and transactional messages, like notifications, alerts, receipts and required communications, and not for marketing campaigns. Apps and devices send through SMTP using HVE account authentication. Admins turn the feature on for specific HVE accounts with a cmdlet. Built-in throttling, quotas and suppression of problem recipients help protect your sending reputation. Billing will be based on…
items.when: GA: March CY2027 · Preview: December CY2026

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Collection Coordinator Skill
items.desc: Start every collections day with one prioritized view of your receivables portfolio that explains each recommendation. The skill shows which customers need attention, why, and what to do next. It helps collectors, collection managers and accounts receivable (AR) leaders act consistently, close periods with fewer surprises, and step in before overdue balances become bad debt.
items.when: GA: February CY2027 · Preview: December CY2026

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Update e-commerce integration with Adyen and introduce ACH and Pay by Bank payment methods
items.desc:
This feature applies to Dynamics 365 Commerce e-commerce. It updates the Adyen API integration to address co-branded card processing requirements and adds support for ACH and Pay by Bank, both directly at checkout and through Pay by Link.
Administrators enable the payment methods available to shoppers through configuration in Commerce and Adyen. Shoppers can then select the enabled methods during e-commerce checkout or when paying through Pay by Link.
The modernization effort will evaluate the latest applicable supported Adyen API version. The target API version and any architectural changes are evaluation objectives, not confirmed…

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: B2B electronic invoicing in Spain
items.desc:
To support Spain's upcoming mandatory B2B electronic invoicing requirements under the Crea y Crece legislation, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance will introduce capabilities for domestic B2B electronic invoicing through a phased rollout.
The planned rollout includes:
Prerequisite data and invoice formats: Support the required master, reference, and configuration data, together with Spain-specific UBL 2.5 electronic invoice formats for outbound and inbound invoices.
Invoice lifecycle management: Introduce capabilities for handling invoice status messages, acknowledgements, rejections, and payment reporting. Delivery timeline to be…

items.title: Planner: Tab support for shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams in GCC, GCC-H and DoD
items.desc: Now you can add Microsoft Planner as a tab in shared and private channels in Microsoft Teams, which allows to create and manage tasks directly within the channel.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pick up where you left off in channels on desktop
items.desc: Stay on top of channel conversations by picking up right where you left off. Choose to open Teams channels at your last read message instead of the most recent message, making it easier to catch up on conversations and follow discussions without losing your place.

items.title: Retirement: Support for Azure Functions OpenAI Extension ends on April 20, 2027
items.desc:
Support for Azure Functions OpenAI extension will end on April 20, 2027. Please migrate to OpenAI, Microsoft Foundry, or Azure AI Search SDKs directly, depending on your scenario, by that date.   
Until you migrate to the appropriate scenario SDK, .NET apps will continue to run, and non-.NET apps can continue to run if configured to use a preview extension bundle version earlier than 4.60.0. However, after April 20, 2027, these apps will be unsupported, and Microsoft will no longer provide security updates, patches, or technical support for the Azure Functions OpenAI extension.
Running function apps on unsupported extension, runtime or…

items.title: Public Preview: Programmed Training in Microsoft Foundry
items.desc:
Programmed Training, an API for building your own post-training loop over open-weight models, is available in public preview in Microsoft Foundry. Access is available by request through the preview sign-up form.
Managed training jobs work well when you only need to choose a dataset, a grader or job settings. Research teams that need a custom learning signal or control over each update have had to run and maintain their own GPU training infrastructure.
With Programmed Training, your Python program controls the experiment while Foundry runs sampling and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) updates on serverless GPUs. Your code decides how rollouts are…

items.title: Public Preview: Multi-turn evaluation in Microsoft Foundry
items.desc:
Multi-turn evaluation is now in public preview in Microsoft Foundry. You can assess complete agent conversations against your quality standards, not only individual responses.
A response can look correct on its own and still be part of a conversation that fails the user. For example, an agent can repeat the same failing action across several turns and leave the request unresolved. Turn-level scores do not show this pattern.
With multi-turn evaluation, you set the evaluation level of a run to score each turn or the conversation as a whole. Conversation-level evaluators, such as task completion, customer satisfaction, coherence, groundedness…

items.title: Public Preview: Azure Firewall for Containers
items.desc:
Azure Firewall for Containers
extends Azure Firewall protection to containerized workloads, providing a
centralized approach to securing network traffic for container environments.
Customers can use Azure Firewall capabilities as part of their container networking
architecture while maintaining consistent network security and control. 
With this preview, organizations can strengthen
protection for container workloads while using Azure Firewall as part of their
broader Azure network security strategy.
Learn
more.

items.title: Announcing: Multiparty private offers in Microsoft Marketplace expands to Malaysia and Saudi Arabia
items.desc: Multiparty private offers give Microsoft partners a way to procure third-party cloud and AI solutions for customers through Marketplace. Software companies can expand into new markets by working with partners that bring established customer relationships, while customers rely on their trusted partners to manage their cloud and AI initiatives.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Voice phishing detection for external calls
items.desc: Voice phishing detection helps protect Microsoft Teams users from potential scams during one-to-one calls with people outside their organization. Using AI, Teams analyzes conversations for signs of social engineering and alerts recipients when suspicious activity is detected, helping them recognize potential threats and decide how to proceed.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Configure a list of allowed external meeting notetaker bots for your Teams meetings
items.desc: Admins will be able to configure more granular and advanced controls for managing external bots and their access to meetings hosted in their organization. Admins will be able to configure a list of external meeting bots which are allowed to join meetings hosted in their organization. Admins can also opt to block all other bots or let them be enforced into the currently available high friction lobby experience. The allowed bots will be treated like a regular external participant to the meeting and meeting policies will be enforced as appropriate.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: PPAC Reporting API
items.desc:
Power Platform reporting API for Copilot credits provides customers with access to Copilot Credit usage from Copilot Studio through the Power Platform API, extending the existing reports available in the Power Platform Admin Center.
Details of the API methods are available in the Microsoft Power Platform API reference - Power Platform API | Microsoft Learn, providing insights into usage by resource, environment, user, and feature. New reports and capabilities will continue to be released.
These reports can be used with Power Platform API credit allocations to monitor and optimize resources and environments that consume Copilot Credits.
items.when: GA: January CY2027 · Preview: November CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator follow-up mode
items.desc: Chat naturally with Facilitator without tagging it each time.
items.when: GA: January CY2027 · Preview: December CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Select Password from the context menu
items.desc: Users can now manually access saved credentials when password suggestions don't appear automatically. When a user right-clicks a recognized username or password field, a new Select Password option appears in the context menu. This provides a reliable fallback path for sign-in scenarios where autofill suggestions are not surfaced, reducing the need for users to copy credentials manually. No configuration is required, and existing password management policies continue to apply.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Assign Study and Learn in Teams and LMS Assignments
items.desc: Educators can assign Study and Learn from Student AI Guidelines in Teams and LMS Assignments. Students open guided learning support grounded in the assignment's title, instructions, and supported files and resources, helping them work through concepts and practice their understanding.
items.when: GA: November CY2026 · Preview: October CY2026

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Provide a Copilot starter prompt in Teams and LMS Assignments
items.desc: Educators can provide a Copilot starter prompt from Student AI Guidelines in Teams and LMS Assignments. Students open Copilot with the educator's prompt ready in their chat, helping them begin with instructions tailored to the assignment.
items.when: GA: November CY2026 · Preview: October CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Teams: PowerPoint Live support for webinars and structured meetings on Teams Rooms on Android
items.desc: Participants joining webinars and structured meetings from Teams Rooms on Android can view and interact with PowerPoint Live presentations. This provides greater flexibility and accessibility while keeping room participants aligned with the active presentation.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Apply default SharePoint library labels to data at rest
items.desc: Enables auto‑labeling of existing SharePoint files to match the default sensitivity label configured on their document library. This helps organizations close labeling gaps for data at rest and ensure consistent, secure‑by‑default protection across SharePoint libraries—without relying on manual user labeling.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Invite attendees to register
items.desc: For an event that needs registration, send email invites to the selected people and groups who will be invited to register to the event

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Chat for organizers and presenters in structured meetings and webinars on Teams Rooms on Android
items.desc: When a Teams Rooms on Android device acts as an organizer, co-organizer, or presenter in a structured meeting or webinar, you have access to the private chat for event management known as the Event Group. You can also switch to a separate chat with attendees, enabling smooth event experiences for all. Available in Teams Rooms Pro-licensed rooms.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Autolaunch opt-in experience for managed devices
items.desc: Microsoft Edge will introduce an opt-in experience that allows users on managed devices to choose whether Edge launches automatically when Windows starts. Administrators can also manage this behavior through the LaunchEdgeOnWindowsStartupEnabled policy with opt-in, opt-out, and user-choice configurations.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out sign language interpreter meeting video for continuous visibility
items.desc: Keep communication more accessible throughout your meeting. You can now pop out a sign language interpreter into a separate, resizable window that stays visible across monitors and apps. Designed to support Deaf and Hard of Hearing users, the sign language interpreter's popout video will persist while viewers are multitasking, sharing content, or changing meeting layouts.
items.when: GA: January CY2027 · Preview: December CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.158 - Inline Switching for Workspaces
items.desc: Workspaces Inline Switching manages multiple Workspaces in a single window. Selecting a Workspace swaps in its tabs, theme, and context, with an easy return to the default space.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.158 - Automatically unsubscribe users from notifications sent by scam and malicious sites
items.desc: Microsoft Edge now helps further protect users from malicious web notifications. When a notification leads users to a site that Microsoft Defender SmartScreen blocks as a scam, phishing, or malware page, Edge automatically stops that source from sending users further notifications and lets users know. Users can review and restore any of these sites anytime under edge://settings/privacy/sitePermissions/allPermissions/notifications.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: v.158 - Import Google account data anytime from Settings
items.desc: Microsoft Edge now lets users import their Google account data - including passwords, bookmarks, history, and autofill data - directly from Edge Settings, at any time after setup. Previously, users had no way to import this data from a Google account outside the first-run experience. With this update, the import flow is unified into a single, streamlined entry point in Settings that combines import from Google Chrome import and Google account.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Triage Agent - Sensitive Data Remediation through Microsoft Teams
items.desc: The Data Security Triage Agent in Data Loss Prevention now offers a new sensitive data remediation function, which empowers organizations to proactively identify and remediate sensitive information—such as Social Security Numbers, passwords, and credit card data—across thousands of files stored in SharePoint or OneDrive locations, dramatically increasing the percentage of remediated files with sensitive information, resulting in reduced compliance risk. Seamlessly integrated with Microsoft Purview, this new agent function automatically detects file(s) with a Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policy match “Needs Attention” alerts and pushes a…
items.when: GA: December CY2027 · Preview: June CY2026

items.title: Generally Available: Azure Cobalt 200 Arm-based Dpsv7, Dplsv7, Epsv7, Mpsv4, and Lpsv5-series Virtual Machines
items.desc:
The general purpose Dpsv7 and Dplsv7, memory-optimized Epsv7, high-memory Mpsv4, and dense storage Lpsv5 VMs are now generally available. These virtual machines deliver significant enhancements over the previous generation Cobalt 100 VMs, offering improved CPU performance, greater scalability, and expanded configuration options to meet the demands of a wide range of workloads. 
Key improvements include:Up to 50% improvement in CPU performance (workload dependent)
20% improvement in remote storage IOPS with NVMe
10% better remote storage throughput with NVMe
15% improvement in network bandwidth
Learn more.
items.when: Private Preview: June 2026 · General Availability: November 2026

items.title:
Microsoft Teams: AI-powered notes for in-person
meetings with Facilitator in Teams Rooms on Android
items.desc: In addition to capturing real-time notes and meeting outcomes during scheduled or hybrid meetings, the Facilitator agent assists you with notes, decisions and actions for in-person meetings in Teams Rooms on Android. Simply invite Facilitator with one tap of the room console. Meeting notes appear on the front of room display or touch board, are available via meeting recap when shared, and deleted if no one selected. Rest assured no data remains in the room. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Call quality feedback surveys for Teams Rooms on Android
items.desc: Users can now rate the quality of their calls and meetings and provide additional feedback on calling, video, and screen-sharing experiences to help organizations ensure consistent, high-quality experiences.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Smarter and faster update application
items.desc: Microsoft Edge can now apply pending updates when your browser is idle. We've updated the Relaunch Notification policy to allow you to manage idle restarts for your organization.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Service principal owner for workflows
items.desc: Workflows can now be owned under a service principal (a Microsoft Entra app registration) instead of a named user account.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Share workflows with co-owners for collaborative editing
items.desc:
Makers can share a workflow with other users as co-owners so they can view, edit, and manage it.
Share from the workflows page or the designer.
Review the connections the workflow uses and their permissions before sharing.
See who the workflow is shared with when reopening Share.
Co-owners can edit and run the workflow.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Generate documents from the Agent node in workflows
items.desc:
The Agent node can now return files that the agent generates, such as PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and CSV, as workflow outputs.
Works with both inline agents and existing (published) agents.
Generated files appear as an ordered files output (name, content type, content) that's available to downstream steps.
Pass files to connectors to email, save to SharePoint/OneDrive, or attach to records.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Run Python code as a step in workflows
items.desc:
The new Code node lets makers run Python as a step in a workflow for logic that expressions and connectors can't handle.
Data transforms, calculations, regex, and advanced parsing.
File conversion and parsing (for example PDF → text, CSV, XML).
Generate the code from natural language with AI, or write and edit it by hand.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Bullseye routing with dynamic user groups and skill relaxation
items.desc: Bullseye routing now supports dynamic user groups and skill relaxation. Administrators can define dynamic groups using representatives’ skills and proficiency levels, and use them at different expansion levels. If work remains unassigned, required skills can be progressively relaxed to broaden the eligible representative pool and improve assignment opportunities—without manually maintaining group membership.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Sensitivity label inheritance for Teams meeting artifacts
items.desc: Teams meeting artifacts, including recordings, transcripts, and Loop notes, can now be configured to automatically inherit the sensitivity label from the meeting. This ensures content generated during meetings is consistently protected without requiring manual labeling, reducing risk and simplifying protection at scale.

items.title: Generally Available: Soft delete in Azure Compute Gallery
items.desc:
Soft delete in Azure Compute Gallery is now generally available, so you can recover image versions that were deleted by accident. You can set a retention period of 7 to 365 days. During retention, you can still deploy from soft-deleted images (API version 2026-03-03). When the retention period ends, a configurable grace period of 7 to 90 days begins. During the grace period, images can no longer be used for deployments but can still be recovered. Soft Delete works with Private, Direct Shared and Community galleries. 
Learn more.

items.title: Public Preview: PostgreSQL 19 on Azure Database for PostgreSQL
items.desc:
You can now try PostgreSQL 19 in public preview on Azure Database for PostgreSQL – Flexible Server in the East Asia region. With this preview, you can provision new PostgreSQL 19 servers through the Azure portal and Azure CLI, enabling you to test major version upgrades from supported earlier PostgreSQL versions to PostgreSQL 19. 
This release gives you early access to PostgreSQL 19 in a fully managed Azure environment and additional time to validate new deployments and upgrade scenarios before general availability. You can test application compatibility, evaluate workloads, and prepare your PostgreSQL estate for broader adoption of…

items.title: Public Preview: Zone resilience for Azure VMs
items.desc:
Zone resilience for Azure VMs, now in public preview, lets you recover an eligible zonal VM in another availability zone in the same region, retaining the existing VM resource and configuration.
ZRS managed disks replicate data synchronously across zones but don't restart an affected VM. Zone resilience reuses supported disks and configuration, with a near-zero recovery point objective (RPO) for data committed to disks.
Key capabilities:
Change zone placement without creating a new VM resource
Recover with existing OS and data disks rather than restoring copies
Choose the target zone and when recovery starts
Zone resilience is a…

items.title: Public Preview: Database Agent for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
items.desc:
Database Agent helps you detect, understand, and respond to database health and performance issues more quickly in Azure Database for PostgreSQL. It proactively monitors database health to identify issues, brings together database metrics, configuration, workload signals, query plans, and logs to determine the likely root cause, and explains the supporting evidence in clear language.  
Database Agent also provides actionable remediation guidance so you can review the evidence and decide what to do next. Instead of manually correlating telemetry and diagnostic data for each issue, you can spend less time investigating database problems and…

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Workspaces updates
items.desc: With new Copilot Workspaces updates, Work IQ can suggest relevant workspaces based on current workstreams to help people get started quickly. Once in a workspace, team members can work together on shared documents while Copilot connects the dots across the work, surfacing what changed, what remains unresolved, and which actions need attention so everyone can quickly catch up and keep the work moving.

items.desc:
Connect your GitHub account to access additional model options for the built-in gen page coding agent directly in the generative page designer in Maker Studio. Makers can use the agent to create and refine generative pages without leaving the Power Apps authoring experience.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Introducing IRM Alert classification
items.desc: Insider risk management will be introducing the ability to classify alerts as True positive, Benign (operational), and False positive. This will be available on all alerts where authorized analysts with the appropriate permissions can choose from a list of predefined classification reasons. Alert classification will help tenants to better classify risk within alerts to support reporting and tuning needs. This will replace existing dismissal reasons.
items.when: GA: January CY2027 · Preview: December CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Simplified Energy Saver
items.desc: Energy saver, formerly known as efficiency mode, will have new defaults and different setting options. Edge will now support and recommend users to use the BatterySaverModeAvailability policy to manage the energy saver feature. The energy saver feature has been simplified to become enabled under two conditions: on low battery or when unplugged. The default will be for energy saver to be enabled on low battery. Energy saver will now have one mode. Users set to Balanced savings will be mapped to have energy saver enabled on low battery. Users set to Maximum savings will be mapped to have energy saver enabled when unplugged.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Seller experiences - Streamline Quick Campaigns for confident, one-time bulk email outreach
items.desc:
Quick Campaigns support multiple bulk activity types (email, tasks, appointments, phone calls). This release focuses on improving the end-to-end experience for bulk email creation, with foundational improvements that benefit the overall Quick Campaigns flow.
Key capabilities include:
Streamlined quick campaign flow: The existing multistep wizard is simplified for Quick Campaigns creation, including one-time bulk email sends. Sellers can create, review, and send bulk emails with fewer steps and clicks, staying in a single creation surface and focusing on execution rather than setup.
In-flow template creation and editing: Sellers can create or…
items.when: GA: November CY2026 · Preview: September CY2026

items.title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Seller experiences - Copy opportunities for repeat deals
items.desc:
Administrators can control whether the Copy Opportunity feature is available. When enabled, sellers can duplicate an existing opportunity to quickly create a new one.
The new opportunity retains key customer, deal, product, stakeholder, and custom-field information from the source opportunity, including hidden custom fields. Product line items are copied with their quantities and pricing; inactive products are excluded and recorded in the audit summary.
To ensure the copied opportunity starts as a new sales deal, system-generated and outcome-related fields are reset. For example, the new opportunity is created with an Open status, and starts…
items.when: GA: August CY2026 · Preview: June CY2026

items.title: Planner: Expiration of plans from meetings due to inactivity
items.desc: Planner plans created from Teams meetings (via Meeting Notes or Loop) often remain unused long after the meeting ends. These inactive plans accumulate and clutter over time. This feature automatically expires and deletes meeting-created plans that have had no task activity for 180 days. Only the Planner plan is removed whereas the tasks in Loop and meeting notes stay intact.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Campaigns Hub in Engage and Engage in Teams mobile
items.desc: The Campaigns Hub in Viva Engage provides a centralized mobile destination where employees can discover and participate in organizational campaigns. Available in the Viva Engage app and Viva Engage in Teams mobile, the hub highlights top and sponsored campaigns, enables users to browse active and completed campaigns, and makes it easy to view campaign details and follow the campaigns that matter to them.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Self-serve sync connectors
items.desc: Self-serve sync connectors enable users to securely connect their own external data sources, such as Jira and Confluence Cloud, to Microsoft 365 Copilot. Using their own credentials and permissions, users can synchronize content they already have access to, making it discoverable in Copilot Chat and Microsoft Search. Administrators maintain oversight through tenant-level controls, including staged rollout, visibility management, and connector disablement.
items.when: GA: September CY2026 · Preview: August CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Campaigns in SharePoint
items.desc: Campaigns in SharePoint (site campaigns) is a new capability that brings Viva Amplify’ s campaign management natively into SharePoint. Corporate communications teams now have a unified place to create, distribute, and measure their news without leaving the platform where their news content already lives. This feature applies only to Amplify users as of now. This is a complementary way to create lighter weight campaigns inside a SharePoint site as a way to organize your SharePoint news posts and benefit from campaign analytics directly from SharePoint.

items.title: SharePoint: Cross-post SharePoint News to Engage
items.desc: This feature allows SharePoint News authors to distribute posts to an Engage community or storyline while preserving full fidelity rendering and a unified conversation experience. SharePoint News post will appear consistently in Engage across feeds, digests, Outlook, Teams, desktop, web and mobile apps. When distributed, the SharePoint News comments module is replaced with the richer Engage conversation module, ensuring a single, shared discussion thread across surfaces.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Security for non-Microsoft connected apps
items.desc: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention and Information Protection Auto-labeling capabilities now extend to non-Microsoft connected apps (e.g., Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Amazon Web Services, and Cisco Webex). The conditions and actions supported for each of these applications vary.
items.when: GA: March CY2027 · Preview: October CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Improved content freshness using Copilot connectors with webhooks-led notifications
items.desc: Copilot connectors will offer improved content freshness with more frequent sync of updates using webhook event notifications. The following connectors are in scope - Azure DevOps, Jira cloud, Confluence cloud, Trello, Asana, Bitbucket, GitHub and Gitlab.
items.when: GA: October CY2026 · Preview: August CY2025

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Improved content freshness using Copilot connectors with webhooks-led notifications
items.desc: Copilot connectors will offer improved content freshness with more frequent sync of updates using webhook event notifications. The following connectors are in scope - Azure DevOps, Jira cloud, Confluence cloud, Trello, Asana, Bitbucket, GitHub and Gitlab.
items.when: GA: August CY2026 · Preview: March CY2026

items.title: Microsoft 365: Create full-workload backup policies for Microsoft 365 Backup
items.desc: Automatically backup all Exchange or OneDrive users and/or SharePoint sites in the tenant and have the tool automatically add new users/sites to the backup policy.
items.when: GA: January CY2027 · Preview: July CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Writing Assistance with Copilot in Edge is being upgraded to include enterprise data protection compliance standards
items.desc: Writing Assistance with Copilot in Edge, which lets users edit typed text for tone, format, and length within an open page in Microsoft Edge, is being updated to include enterprise data protection for commercial customers. Once Writing Assistance is available, users signed in with a Microsoft Entra ID will have enterprise data protection when using the feature in Microsoft Edge.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Viva Engage - Topic Subscription notification
items.desc: This feature allows users to subscribe to notifications for Viva Engage topics they follow. Users will receive a Viva Engage bell notification when a new post is tagged with a topic they are subscribed to or when the topic is added to an existing post.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Microsoft 365 admin centers –  Manage Teams apps that work on Outlook and Microsoft 365 App
items.desc: Administrators using the Microsoft 365 admin center and Teams admin center who manage Teams apps that work on Outlook and the Microsoft 365 App will be able to apply their changes across all three clients (Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 App). Before this update, changes made through the Integrated Apps section in the Microsoft 365 admin center would only affect these apps on Outlook and the Microsoft 365 App; similarly, changes made in the Teams admin center would exclusively affect Teams. With this change, management of these apps will be unified across Teams, Outlook and Microsoft 365 App.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Search in Viva Connections on iOS and Android tablet
items.desc: This adds a search entry point and a new tailored experience for Viva Connection users on iOS and Android tablets.

items.title: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: False positive email release from Quarantine through threat explorer, email summary panel, advanced hunting, and custom detection email entity page take action
items.desc: SecOps can now mange False positives and take move to inbox (i.e. release) quarantined messages from Threat explorer, advanced hunting, custom detection and Email entity page without the need to tab out to the Quarantine portal to take the action.
items.when: GA: July CY2024 · Preview: November CY2023

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Unified Pricing Management - Manage purchase prices and discounts with attribute-based pricing

Disaster recovery for Azure Functions durable task scheduler is now available in public preview for the Dedicated SKU in supported Azure regions.
Recover business-critical workflows from regional outages without rebuilding orchestration state, with a repeatable path to resume processing in another region.
Customers can pair a primary scheduler with a passive secondary scheduler in another region. Durable task scheduler replicates orchestration state to the paired scheduler and provides a customer-initiated planned failover operation, reducing the custom recovery engineering required for regulated and mission-critical workloads.
The preview…

items.title: Generally Available: Customer-managed keys for Azure Functions durable task scheduler
items.desc:
Customer-managed keys for Azure Functions Durable Task Scheduler are now generally available for Dedicated SKU schedulers.Organizations that need to manage their own encryption keys can now use customer-managed keys to protect their workflow data, supporting separation of duties, centralized auditing of key access, and customer-defined key rotation policies.
Customers can use a key they own in Azure Key Vault or Azure Managed Hardware Security Module (HSM) to protect scheduler data at rest. Configuration is available through the ARM REST API, Azure CLI using az rest, or Bicep. 
Learn more.

items.title: Public Preview: Network Watcher VNet Flow Logs enriched with networkInterfaceIP field
items.desc:
Azure Network Watcher VNet
Flow Logs now provides enhanced capture-side interface context with the
networkInterfaceIP field. 
The networkInterfaceIP
field records the IP address or addresses of the network interface where a flow
was captured, making it easier to identify the resource associated with the
captured traffic, determine the next hops in the network traffic flow, and attribute
flow records to the correct resource ID. 
This additional context
provides greater visibility into how traffic moves through your network,
including for interfaces using IPv4 or dual-stack addressing. It helps you
trace traffic paths, identify the resources…

items.title: Public Preview: Network Watcher Private Link support
items.desc:
Azure Network Watcher VNet
Flow Logs now supports flow log enrichment for Azure Private Link Service,
providing greater visibility into network traffic flowing through Private Link
Service. With this capability,
Virtual Network Flow Logs retain backend flow details while adding context
about the original source, translated Private Link Service address information, and the Private
Link connection identifier. This helps service providers trace connections from
the original client, through the Private Endpoint and Private Link Service translation layer, to
the backend workload. 
Traffic Analytics also
supports this enriched Private Link Service…

items.title: Public Preview: Network Watcher rule recommendation
items.desc:
Azure Network Watcher rule recommendation
is now in public preview, helping you proactively identify opportunities to
improve network security based on observed network traffic. 
With this capability, you
can use Traffic Analytics insights to identify network security rules that may
be overly permissive or no longer required. Rule recommendation analyzes
observed traffic patterns and provides actionable recommendations to help you
strengthen your network security posture while maintaining required
connectivity. 
You can review
recommendations, drill down into the supporting traffic insights, and use this
context to make informed decisions…

items.title: Public Preview: Azure Functions support for Python 3.15
items.desc:
Azure Functions support for Python 3.15 is now in public preview.
Developers can evaluate Python applications, dependencies, native extensions and deployment workflows using the existing v1 and v2 programming models.
Dependency overlap between the Python worker’s gRPC messaging packages and application dependencies can create compatibility conflicts. A new Rust-based transport addresses this by handling host messaging and embedding CPython without depending on the Python grpcio and protobuf packages, reducing dependency overlap and introducing performance benefits. Applications can still use these packages, and existing Python execution…

items.title: Public Preview: Azure Functions support for Node.js 26
items.desc:
Azure Functions support for Node.js 26 is now in public preview.
Developers can evaluate their JavaScript and TypeScript function apps on the new runtime while continuing to use the Azure Functions programming model on Linux in the Flex Consumption, Elastic Premium, and Dedicated (App Service) plans. Linux Consumption is not supported. Support for Windows hosting plans will roll out in the future.
Learn
more.

items.title: Generally Available: Golang support on Azure Functions Flex Consumption
items.desc:
First-class Go support on Azure Functions Flex Consumption is now generally available.
The Go worker offers a code-first programming model with typed Go handlers, standard Go modules, and integration with Azure Functions Core Tools and Azure CLI. Developers can build HTTP APIs, scheduled jobs, event-processing applications, integration workloads, and durable workflows without introducing a second application language or a custom-handler abstraction.
The release supports Azure Functions triggers, typed batch processing, Blob Storage SDK client injection, and generic registration for compatible extensions. It also includes HTTP streaming,…

items.title: Public Preview: Azure App Service Builder
items.desc:
Turning application code into a running cloud app often requires developers to configure build pipelines, deployment workflows, and hosting infrastructure. Azure App Service Builder simplifies that journey with a source-connected platform for building, deploying, and running web applications on Azure. Developers and AI coding agents can connect a GitHub repository and deploy a static site, backend web app, or frontend-plus-API application while the service manages the underlying build and hosting infrastructure. Portal, CLI, and guided GitHub Copilot app experience bring deployment into the workflows developers already use.
Learn more.

items.title: Generally Available: Private endpoints for Azure Functions durable task scheduler
items.desc:
Private endpoints for Azure Functions durable task scheduler are now generally available for both Dedicated and Consumption SKU schedulers. 
Customers can connect Azure Functions and other durable task SDK workloads to a scheduler through a private IP address in their virtual network using Azure Private Link. Traffic remains on the Microsoft backbone instead of traversing the public internet, and customers can disable public network access so the scheduler accepts traffic only through approved private endpoints. 
The private endpoint uses the scheduler's existing endpoint and Microsoft Entra authentication model, allowing applications to…

items.title: Generally Available: Durable Task extension for Microsoft Agent Framework
items.desc:
The Durable Task extension for Microsoft Agent Framework is now generally available for C# and
Python. 
Build agents,
multi-agent orchestrations, and Microsoft Agent Framework workflows that can run reliably
for minutes, days, or weeks. The extension persists agent sessions, checkpoints
orchestration and workflow progress, and automatically resumes work after LLM
rate limits, network timeouts, process restarts, scale events, or
infrastructure failures without requiring custom recovery logic.   
The extension
supports two hosting models. Customers can use Azure Functions for managed,
serverless hosting with automatic scaling and generated…

items.title: Public Preview: Geo-redundancy on Azure App Service
items.desc:
Geo-redundancy in Azure App Service, now in public preview, helps customers build more resilient web applications across Azure regions without independently creating and managing an App Service deployment in each region. App Service creates and manages regional application replicas, synchronizes supported application content and configuration, and provides a global endpoint for traffic across regions. Customers can choose Passive mode for regional failover or Active mode to distribute traffic across healthy regions.
Learn more.

items.title: Public Preview: Hosted Skill and Agent Bindings for Azure Functions
items.desc:
Hosted Skill and Agent bindings for Azure Functions are now available in public preview. Adding agents to an application often requires setup and lifecycle code before developers can focus on business logic. These bindings reduce that plumbing while keeping your function code in control of validation, when agents run, and how results are used.
Choose from three approaches:
Hosted Skill Binding: Invoke Markdown-defined hosted skill through a simple API without working directly with the underlying agent SDK. Reuse skill configuration, tools, and conversation history, with support for streaming results and continuing conversations.
Microsoft…

items.title: Public Preview: OS-level dependency support via containers for Azure Functions Flex Consumption
items.desc:
OS-level dependency support via containers for Azure Functions Flex Consumption is now in preview. 
Previously, Flex Consumption apps ran in a Microsoft-managed worker environment that customers couldn’t extend with native executables, system libraries, or other OS-level components. Workloads with these requirements often had to be redesigned, move the dependency to a separate service, or use another hosting option. You can now build a Linux worker image that packages your function code, a supported Azure Functions language worker, language dependencies, and required OS-level software. This enables scenarios such as browser automation with…

items.title: Public Preview: Azure Functions Network Troubleshooter v2
items.desc:
Azure Functions Network Troubleshooter v2 is now in Public Preview. 
Network Troubleshooter v2 gives customers a top-down view of Function App dependencies across Storage, Service Bus, and Azure Files. For each supported dependency, customers can inspect connectivity status and verify whether Managed Identity is configured correctly. By bringing dependency discovery and these checks into one experience, it reduces the need to diagnose connectivity and configuration issues separately. There are no plan, region, or Managed Identity prerequisites or limitations. 
Learn more.

items.title: Public Preview: Task Queues for Azure Functions durable task scheduler
items.desc:
Task Queues for Azure Functions durable task scheduler are now available in public preview. Workloads sharing a task hub can have different throughput requirements and downstream service limits. Create named queues within a task hub and configure a shared actions-per-second dispatch rate for orchestration and activity work.
Select a queue by setting the DTS_TaskQueue tag to the queue’s name when starting a workflow. Teams can pace workloads and assign separate throughput budgets without changing function names. The rate controls work-item dispatch, not execution concurrency.
Learn more.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Expanded enforcement controls for Data Loss Prevention connectors
items.desc: Microsoft Edge for Business is expanding its existing Data Loss Prevention Enterprise Connector capabilities. Administrators will be able to configure more consistent enforcement across download, upload, paste, and print workflows. Additional controls include required bypass justification and administrator-defined guidance.

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Engage - Improved shared messages end-user experience
items.desc: Improving the shared conversation experience in Viva Engage to so it's easier for users to discover, read, and participate.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Reroute conversations to the right queue automatically
items.desc: Service representatives can reroute a live voice or messaging conversation when they realize they aren't the right person to help. The representative updates the conversation details, or the details of a linked case, contact, or account, and then selects Reroute. The conversation goes back through classification and route-to-queue rules and is assigned to the right queue automatically, so representatives don't need to know routing rules or choose a queue themselves. The customer stays connected throughout, and the next representative receives the conversation with its full history and updated context. Admins choose whether to turn on Reroute…

items.title: Power Apps: Form fill assistance supports more field types
items.desc:
We’re expanding form fill assistance in model-driven applications in Power Apps to support lookup, rich text, and multi-select choice fields, helping users complete more of their forms with AI-powered suggestions and less manual entry.

items.desc: AI-powered Data Enrichment now lets admins choose which data sources the agent uses to enrich records. Outlook emails, Teams meetings, and the new CRM notes source each have their own control toggle, and the agent keeps running as long as at least one source is toggled on. Admins no longer need to connect every permission before they create the agent. With CRM notes, the agent extracts insights from manual notes added to supported records and uses them to enrich those records, with no tenant admin consent needed to use CRM notes. Only notes added by users with a Dynamics 365 Sales Premium license are used, and Dataverse search is needed only…

items.title: Microsoft Viva: Ability for leaders to publish Power BI reports
items.desc: Microsoft Viva Insights is extending its report publishing capabilities from analysts to leader personas such as Chief Officers, Managers and their delegates. This enhancement enables leaders to directly distribute curated reports within their organizations through a lightweight publishing experience, complementing the existing report customization features.

items.title: Generally Available: Network egress controls for hosted agents in Microsoft Foundry
items.desc:
Network egress controls for hosted agents in Foundry Agent Service are now generally available.
Create rules that allow or deny destinations, or rewrite destinations. Audit mode logs deny decisions without blocking them. Rewrite rules still take effect.
Header transformation rules are in preview and also take effect in audit mode.
Learn more.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Scope evaluation control with recipient and site owner lifecycle status
items.desc: Microsoft Purview Adaptive Scopes will provide administrators with explicit control over lifecycle-state evaluation for recipients and site owners, helping ensure policy targeting and scope membership remain aligned with organizational requirements.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection - Sensitivity Labels for Microsoft Entra Security Groups
items.desc: Apply sensitivity labels to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups to extend the classification and governance you already use for Microsoft 365 groups. The same labels you publish in the Microsoft Purview portal and configure for groups and sites apply automatically to cloud security groups, with no separate label configuration required.

items.title: Outlook: New Copilot entry point in Classic Outlook
items.desc: We've introduced a new experience for Copilot in the apps—a consistent entry point across apps that sits above your work and understands the context beneath it. Rather than scattering touchpoints across the interface, it anchors Copilot as one connected system across Microsoft 365, surfacing relevant actions that help you stay in flow. With this release, we are rolling out this new experience - already available across other Outlook endpoints, as well as in Word, Excel and PowerPoint - to classic Outlook.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Azure PST Import
items.desc: Azure PST Import is a migration method that enables PST files stored in Azure Blob Storage to be imported directly into Exchange Online mailboxes. It follows the standard two‑step Exchange Migration Service pattern: an initial analysis phase to validate and assess PST data, followed by execution of the actual migration. The process also involves creating a migration endpoint, running an analysis-only migration batch, using the analysis results to configure the final batch, and then starting the batch to import PST content into target mailboxes.

items.title: Generally Available: Semantic chunking and image descriptions with Azure Content Understanding in Foundry IQ
items.desc:
Foundry IQ—formerly Azure AI Search—now offers generally available semantic chunking and optional AI-generated image descriptions through the Azure Content Understanding skill.
The skill uses document structure to create chunks with Markdown and location metadata. Configure a supported chat-model deployment to generate descriptions of supported images, charts, and diagrams.
Learn more.

items.title: Generally Available: MCP server knowledge sources in Foundry IQ
items.desc:
Foundry IQ supported Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers as federated knowledge sources, is generally available. Customers register an MCP server as a read-only knowledge source in Foundry IQ. MCP knowledge sources participate in Foundry IQ cross-source selection alongside other knowledge sources, such as web search and unstructured data in blob storage synced into Azure AI Search vector indexes. 
Learn more.

items.title: Generally Available: Snapshot backup for SQL Server in Azure VMs
items.desc:
Azure Backup now supports snapshot-based backup for SQL Server running on Azure Virtual Machines. This new capability uses Azure disk snapshots combined with native SQL transaction log backups to deliver near-instant, low-impact full backups for large SQL databases, significantly improving backup performance and reducing the load on production workloads compared to streaming backups. You can protect multiple databases under a SQL instance with a single policy and restore using different mechanisms with point-in-time recovery enabled by log chaining on top of snapshot recovery points.
All restore points get stored in Azure Recovery Services…

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - DLM Meter Change
items.desc: Data Lifecycle Management (DLM) billing will be based on the volume of data retained. For example, any number of non‑Microsoft 365 generative AI prompts and responses that collectively amount to 1 GB of retained data will be billed at $0.25 per GB per month (equivalent to ~$0.0082 per GB per day). In the updated model, DLM is billed based on the total volume of text messages managed by a DLM policy. Each non‑Microsoft 365 generative AI prompt and response is treated as an individual text message and is retained and deleted according to the configured Microsoft Purview retention settings. Billing is calculated on the managed text messages in…

items.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Invoke agents as workflow steps with the agent node
items.desc: Add an agent node to your workflow to reason over data, call tools, and return a response, all within a single step. The agent node lets you embed reasoning directly into your workflow. This means fewer manual handoffs, faster processing times, and workflows that can handle nuanced decisions without additional development effort, helping teams automate more of their end-to-end processes and reduce operational overhead.
items.when: GA: September CY2026 · Preview: April CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Improved website compatibility with site troubleshooting controls
items.desc: Microsoft Edge is introducing improvements to help users quickly resolve website issues directly from the browser. When a site is not functioning as expected, users may be guided to relevant troubleshooting options such as adjusting tracking prevention settings (e.g., Strict mode) and reviewing site-specific configurations. This experience surfaces relevant actions in-context to help users restore site functionality without navigating deep into settings.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Copilot and agents - Fill forms faster with Autofill - Auto paste
items.desc:
Save time entering information into Business Central with Auto paste. Building on Autofill, Auto paste uses AI to identify relevant information from text or HTML copied to your clipboard and map it to the appropriate fields on a Business Central page.
Benefits
Reduce manual data entry when bringing information from external sources into Business Central.
Populate multiple relevant fields from copied content instead of copying and pasting individual values.
Extend AI-assisted data entry to more everyday Business Central workflows.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Enable Project and Item Requirement delivery address
items.desc:
Enable Project and Item Requirement Delivery Address Management
This feature extends delivery address capabilities within integrated Project Operations by introducing delivery address support on Project, Project Task, and Material Estimate records. Delivery addresses can be selected from customer addresses, defaulted through the project hierarchy, and synchronized between Dataverse and Finance and Operations.
The enhancement also ensures that delivery addresses are correctly resolved and populated on Item Requirements regardless of how they are created, whether from Item Forecasts, Project Purchase Orders, or directly from Projects. This…
items.when: GA: January CY2028 · Preview: January CY2027

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Configure quick operations on the transaction screen
items.desc:
Applies to: Point of Sale (Store Commerce)
Setup: Store admin configures the control in the Commerce headquarters screen layout designer.
You can add a new Quick Operations control to the transaction screen layout in the headquarters screen layout designer.
Display a configurable set of operations in a purpose-built experience instead of a generic button grid. For example, include manual discount amount, manual discount percentage, transaction comments, and customer purchase order numbers.
Configure operations per screen layout. The control respects POS permissions and hides or disables actions based on user access. Operations use the same…
items.when: GA: December CY2026 · Preview: July CY2026

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Cross-Tenant Orchestrated Migration
items.desc: Cross-Tenant Orchestrated Migration for User Data Migration (UDM) and Shared Data Migration (SDM) allows customers to move their Microsoft 365 data from one Microsoft tenant to another. UDM includes the ability to move user mailboxes, OneDrive accounts, Teams chats, and Teams meetings. SDM includes the ability to move M365 Groups, SharePoint Sites, Group Mailboxes, and teams and channels.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Microsoft Learning Zone - Minecraft connected lessons
items.desc:
Bring Minecraft Education to every classroom with AI-powered tools that match curriculum goals to Build Challenges, blend lessons with project-based learning, launch directly from Learning Zone, and give you full visibility into participation, completion, and student understanding.
#education

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Build audiences faster with reusable segment templates
items.desc: Segment templates help you build audiences without recreating queries for each campaign. Choose a built-in template for common scenarios such as event attendance or email engagement, or save your own segment query as a reusable custom template. Add placeholders with hint text to guide marketers through entering campaign-specific values, reducing repetitive setup while keeping audience criteria consistent.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Finance: Submit only validated records to Dynamics 365 Finance
items.desc: The write to business rules engine configuration experience introduces an option to submit only records that have successfully passed Account structure validation. When enabled, Business Performance Planning filters the writeback dataset and submits only records marked as valid by account structure validation to the business rules engine writeback process. Records that have not passed validation are excluded from the submission so users can review and correct them before attempting to write them to Dynamics 365 Finance.

items.title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Practice presentations with Speaker Coach in Learning Activities
items.desc:
In learning activities, students can rehearse presentations, receive feedback on their delivery, and practice again with targeted suggestions to improve clarity and confidence.
#education

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Top sites in Edge search bar
items.desc: Adding easy access to top sites in Edge search bar on desktop. Users can add, edit, remove, or hide top sites. Admins can control available to this feature using the NewTabPageManagedQuickLinks and NewTabPageQuickLinksEnabled policies.

items.title: Outlook: Copilot Chat Sheet UX Update for Mobile
items.desc: Copilot Chat in Outlook on iOS and Android is getting updated! You'll notice smoother animations, improved strings, and some small changes to the header, such as the new/temporary chat button being moved behind the ... button.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Send each message only once with deduplication for SMS and custom channels
items.desc:
Deduplicates recipients by contact point, so each phone number or custom channel address gets the message once per send.
Eliminates manual post-send clean-up, wasted messaging spend and the customer annoyance of duplicate texts.
Brings SMS and custom channels to parity with email's built-in deduplication.

items.title: Power Automate: Credentials - Integration with Delinea secret server
items.desc: Power Automate will support Delinea Secret Server as an external credential provider for desktop flows. Organizations can securely use credentials managed in Delinea for machine sign-in and credential retrieval during attended and unattended automation.

items.title: Power Automate: Direct triggers for desktop flows
items.desc: Desktop flows will support direct triggers, enabling automations to start in response to supported events without requiring an intermediary cloud flow. This simplifies automation design and reduces the effort required to connect desktop flows to business processes.
items.when: GA: March CY2027 · Preview: January CY2027

items.title: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Create event experience that match your business structure by supporting leads, contacts, or both​
items.desc:
Align event registrations with the way your organization manages customer data. By supporting lead-based registration journeys and existing matching rules, you can avoid unnecessary Contact creation, improve data quality, and ensure event attendees follow the same lead management process used across your business.​
Configure event registration forms to create or update Contacts, Leads, or both Leads and Contacts ​
Apply existing matching, deduplication, and update rules to event registrations for more consistent and accurate customer data.​
Register attendees without requiring a Contact record, enabling lead-only registration scenarios and…

items.title: Microsoft 365 app: Inventory - Update Repair
items.desc: Update Repair helps admins identify Windows devices with Microsoft 365 Apps that are out of date or experiencing update issues. In the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center, admins can review device status and recommended actions, remotely start Online Repair for eligible devices, and follow manual remediation guidance for devices that need attention. Repair reinstalls Microsoft 365 Apps using the latest available build for the device’s configured update channel.
items.when: GA: November CY2026 · Preview: October CY2026

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft M365): Delegated prompt publishing for organization prompts
items.desc: This release follows the availability of organization prompts, providing admins the ability to upload custom prompts for their organization in the Copilot app home screen. Now, admins can delegate organization prompt publishing to users, AAD security groups, and distribution groups. These delegated users and groups will be able to create, edit and delete organization prompts at the tenant level through the Prompt Lab, without having to access the Microsoft 365 Admin Center. Admins can continue to monitor and provide oversight through the current experience in the Microsoft 365 Admin Center.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: E-Documents - Self-billing enablement
items.desc:
Streamline self-billing by automatically creating, managing, and exchanging electronic documents for self-billed invoices as part of the invoice lifecycle. This reduces manual document handling while helping ensure self-billed transactions include the appropriate electronic documents in standardized formats used by local regulations and trading partners.
Benefits
• Automate electronic document generation and handling for self-billed invoices.
• Integrate electronic documents directly into the self-billing invoice lifecycle.
• Support consistent vendor communications and the use of standardized electronic document formats.
items.when: GA: January CY2027 · Preview: November CY2026

items.title: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Design receipts using a modern, web-based designer in headquarters and print them on A4 paper or thermal printers from Store Commerce, supporting B2B scenarios
items.desc:

The modern receipt designer introduces a React-based designer in headquarters at Retail and Commerce > Channel setup > POS setup > POS > Receipt formats > Designer. Users can author receipts in the browser with live preview, without installing the legacy desktop designer host. The legacy designer remains available for existing formats.
The feature adds a new receipt schema in RetailFormLayout, syncs it to the channel database, and uses ReceiptService v2 to return structured, platform-agnostic…
items.when: GA: December CY2026 · Preview: September CY2026

items.title: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Quality Evaluation Agent - Review historical quality metrics in a unified dashboard
items.desc: The quality evaluation historical dashboard provides aggregated insights from completed evaluations, helping organizations track quality trends over time. Users can view quality scores and trends across selected date ranges, with up to two years of historical data available.
items.when: GA: March CY2027 · Preview: September CY2026

items.title: Outlook: Keep folder sharing within your organization's policies
items.desc: Folder sharing in Outlook will respect your organization's restrictions for Default and Anonymous permissions. When these restrictions are enabled, you won't be able to change either setting. Permissions granted directly to individual users will remain unaffected. This helps keep folder sharing aligned with your organization's policies. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Sort your subfolders from A to Z
items.desc: You'll be able to sort a folder's subfolders alphabetically from the parent folder. This makes it easier to find the folder you need without rearranging subfolders one by one. It's a simple way to keep long folder lists organized. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Keep folders expanded when you restart Outlook
items.desc: Outlook will remember which folders and shared mailboxes you have expanded or collapsed when you restart the app. You can pick up where you left off without opening the same folder branches again. This makes returning to your usual folders easier. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Remember your online archive folder pane state
items.desc: Outlook will remember whether your online archive is expanded or collapsed when you return. Outlook on the web and the new Outlook for Windows will each keep their own saved state. This saves you from repeatedly expanding or collapsing your archive as you navigate your mailbox. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: Expand or collapse all accounts at once
items.desc: You'll be able to expand or collapse all accounts at once in Outlook's folder pane. You won't need to expand or collapse each account individually. This makes it easier to navigate multiple accounts or keep your folder pane compact. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Outlook: More visibility into usage for recoverable items storage
items.desc: You'll be able to see how much storage your recoverable items are using in Outlook. This gives you a clearer picture of your storage usage before you reach a limit. You can use this information to make more informed decisions about managing your mailbox. #newoutlookforwindows

items.title: Work IQ: Business Skills to manage your business processes in Work IQ MCP
items.desc:
Business skills are natural-language instructions that capture how your organization gets work done. They represent your business processes, policies, and domain knowledge in a format that agents can understand and follow. Each skill describes how to complete a specific type of work—the steps involved, the information required, and the business rules that apply.
Agents discover and use the business skills they have access to as needed at runtime using Work IQ MCP to complete tasks according to your organization's processes. When multiple agents use the same skill, they follow the same process, ensuring consistent behavior across your…

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Cowork: Access Business Applications with Work IQ
items.desc: Users can access Business Applications through Work IQ in Copilot Cowork and use Business Skills to complete end-to-end business processes grounded in their enterprise data and apps. items.title: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities
items.desc: Microsoft Planner will be updated with a cleaner, more modern interface, improved navigation, responsive layouts, and a more consistent experience across Planner in Teams and Planner for the web.

Copilot can bring content from across WorkIQ as well as complete actions across other workflows such as creating Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.
